name: Frame Window Counter
description: Frame Window Counter (FB-style) with Auto & Manual modes, color-coded click circles, customizable bell pitch, S-Frames/Swifts/Multiclicks, TPS adaptation, and bot/render compatibility.

enabled.name: Enable Mod
enabled.description: Toggle the entire Frame Window Counter overlay and logic.

mode.name: Counter Mode
mode.description: Choose between automatic real-time estimation (auto) and manual marker playback (manual).

ref-fps.name: Reference FPS / Scale
ref-fps.description: Reference FPS used to display frame counts (e.g. 6000 FPS -> 100F = 60Hz, <76F = ~80Hz FP).

auto-tps-adapt.name: Adapt to Live TPS
auto-tps-adapt.description: Automatically measure live physics TPS from game delta time (bot & speedhack safe).

show-circles.name: Show Click Circles
show-circles.description: Render animated color-coded rings over the player on every click.

show-circle-label.name: Show Frame Label on Circle
show-circle-label.description: Display frame count and click tag next to each click circle.

show-hud.name: Show Bottom-Left HUD
show-hud.description: Display the bottom-left frame counter stats card.

show-percentages.name: Show Percentages in HUD
show-percentages.description: Display Frame Perfect % and estimated Pass Probability %.

show-special-stats.name: Show S-Frames / Swifts / Multiclicks
show-special-stats.description: Track and display S-Frames, Swift clicks, and Multiclicks in the HUD.

show-banner.name: Show Intro Showcase Banner
show-banner.description: Show the level info & color legend banner at the start of each attempt.

banner-duration.name: Banner Duration (sec)
banner-duration.description: How long the intro banner stays visible in game seconds.

banner-comment.name: Banner Comment / Tag
banner-comment.description: Custom subtitle shown next to level name (e.g. Open Window Top 1).

show-raw-precision.name: Show Raw Precision Line
show-raw-precision.description: Show the precision badge line inside the intro showcase banner.

raw-precision-text.name: Raw Precision Text
raw-precision-text.description: Custom precision label shown in the intro banner.

sound-enabled.name: Enable Bell Sounds
sound-enabled.description: Play a bell chime sound on clicks.

sound-pitch.name: Bell Base Pitch
sound-pitch.description: Base playback pitch multiplier for bell chimes.

dynamic-pitch.name: Dynamic Pitch by Tightness
dynamic-pitch.description: Automatically shift pitch higher on tighter frame windows.

swift-threshold-ms.name: Swift Click Threshold (ms)
swift-threshold-ms.description: Maximum hold duration in ms to classify a click as a Swift click.

multiclick-window-ms.name: Multiclick Window (ms)
multiclick-window-ms.description: Maximum time between clicks in ms to count as a Multiclick.

auto-sensitivity.name: Auto Estimator Sensitivity
auto-sensitivity.description: Calibration multiplier for automatic hitbox-gap frame window estimation.

capture-to-manual.name: Capture Clicks to Manual List
capture-to-manual.description: Automatically record clicks from your run/bot into the Manual Markers list.
